profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc. is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, trading under the ticker PEGA. Its website describes the company as "the leading AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation," and states that since 1983 the world's largest organizations have trusted Pega to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems.

The site highlights Pega AI as grounded in best practices with governance built in, and says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight. It names Pega Platform as a product for mission-critical work and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together.

Pegasystems has 191 legal matters in Massachusetts.
